subject: Status: profiling repro + an integration snag
body:
Status on profiling and integration.

Repro: runtime results line up with the paper — the fast clipping path shows clear gains over naive per-example clipping on the fully connected targets (fc1), and especially on the embedding-layer experiment (emb1), where the gap widens with vocab size. Our profiler is now wired into get_compute_profile and get_train_bert_model_compute_profile, so we get peak-memory curves the public repo can't produce. On bert1, fast clipping keeps peak memory roughly flat where the naive path grows with batch size — that's the headline for the cost memo.

Risk: Leilani's integration flag currently conflicts with our momentum-optimizer wrapper — in one code path gradients get clipped after accumulation instead of before. Fix is understood but touches the optimizer interface; adds maybe four days. Still tracking May 29 for the flag.

Bilal
